BEFORE YOU APPLY

A photo that fits the brief.

Choose the exact application, not just the country. Presets help with dimensions and file size. Your application portal and embassy have the final say.

A few useful details

Composition guides are visual aids, not face detection. Keep the entire head visible; leave the required space around it. Padding does not remove or change your original background.

Millimetres and inches convert to pixels using your chosen DPI. JPG and PNG exports include that print density. Print physical-size presets at their stated size, with automatic scaling turned off.

KB = 1,000 bytes and MB = 1,000,000 bytes here. If a limit can’t be reached without reducing quality further, the app shows the actual size instead of changing your dimensions. PNG is lossless; choose JPG or WebP for smaller files.

Photos are decoded and re-encoded on your device. Original EXIF metadata, including location, is not copied. This app does not retouch faces or replace backgrounds.

Sources checked 9 October 2026. Requirements may change.
